title: Polar-X4 over-temperature response
content: For freezer FZ-101, verify the door seal, inspect the condenser airflow, and dispatch P1 maintenance when three readings exceed -15 C and an open work order exists.

title: Polar-X4 closed work order guidance
content: For freezer FZ-201, do not dispatch maintenance when the related work order is Closed unless a new anomaly is confirmed.

title: Arctic-A1 monitoring guidance
content: For freezer FZ-301, keep monitoring and schedule a P2 inspection when readings stay warmer than -15 C without an open work order.
